fewer_alerts.selection: Source calibration only: maximize window precision at sensitivity >=0.70, with threshold strictly above standard. Ties favor the higher threshold.
fewer_alerts.tradeoff: Fewer alerts can mean more missed AKI. The 70% sensitivity floor is a demo policy on source calibration, not a guarantee externally.
